name: infimem
description: Governable, evaluable long-term memory engine for AI agents. SQLite single-file, MCP-first, transparent retrieval pipeline.

scripts.eval: node dist/cli/index.js eval --suite eval/suites/v1.jsonl --name v1 --report eval/reports/latest
scripts.eval:baseline: node dist/cli/index.js eval --suite eval/suites/v1.jsonl --name v1 --report eval/reports && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('eval/reports/report.json','eval/reports/baseline.json')"
scripts.eval:regress: node dist/cli/index.js eval --suite eval/suites/v1.jsonl --name v1 --baseline eval/reports/baseline.json --fail-on-regression
